score_definition.name: Public-evidence fit (triage only)
score_definition.scale: Five dimensions scored 0–4; total /20; displayed /10 is total divided by two.
dimensions: Direct paid signal: whether a page-resolved, active Meta Ad Library record was observed.
Bengaluru relevance: strength of explicit local evidence in the creative or first-party material.
Public CTA visibility: how clearly the public card exposes a next step, not whether it converts.
First-party source coverage: breadth of official product, store, contact or corporate evidence reviewed.
Contact-route relevance: fit of the published route to a request for the paid-media owner; no buyer identity is inferred.
score_definition.qualification: This is a public-evidence and routing score, not an effectiveness or revenue score, sales probability, spend estimate, forecast, or ROI claim. Private account and conversion results were not accessed.

scope_decisions: Working target: ten new leads, subject to page-resolved ad evidence, first-party contact provenance and duplicate checks across data/seen_leads.json and every existing niches/ folder. No candidate is included on a keyword-only ad result.

All ten selected Meta cards were individually opened and showed the named page/card label, Sponsored/Active status, start date and direct Library ID on 04 Oct 2026. A selected card is not an account-wide count; public inventory changes daily.

Liliyum, Mixnosh Art Cafe and The Cuisine Story had an unavailable/unpublished surrounding page response while the exact individual card still rendered Active/Sponsored. Their reports make only card-level claims and preserve the page-response caveat.

Chelvies Coffee's selected individual card 1448800300746966 was visible in accessible direct advertiser-page results, while its standalone static fetch returned HTTP 403; both links and the limitation are recorded.

Fish Mart's selected contact email is taken from indexed contact/structured-data snippets on its own website because direct static page extraction did not render the email; verify this route before sending.

Google Ads Transparency any-time/domain results are not current-ad counts. NATUF's natuf.com result was under a different verified advertiser and was not tied to NATUF; Liliyum's brand-specific creative was last shown 03 Oct and marked removed, not current active status; zero results do not prove no activity.

Domino's India was not selected because the official Jubilant FoodWorks profile lists Domino's and Popeyes among its franchise brands, while Popeyes India is already in the pack under Jubilant FoodWorks Limited. It was excluded to avoid repeating corporate-group outreach; see https://www.jubilantfoodworks.com/about-us/company-profile and the existing LEADS-INDEX.csv entry.

No site tags, pixels, rendered event firing, spend, ROAS, CPA, orders, bookings or conversion outcomes were measured or estimated. No audience targeting is inferred from city copy or first-party location pages.
score_note: Triage of public paid, local, CTA, first-party and contact-route evidence only; not an effectiveness or revenue score.
